evals.name: analysis-failure-blocks-apply
evals.prompt: Run a whole-tree health audit. audit-placement, candidate detection and the standalone-cap sweep succeeded, but one meta-validate invocation crashed; referents --status succeeded. I have authorized the proposed rebalance in advance. What is the correct state before APPLY?
evals.expected_output: The failed analytic is N/A; no partial baseline or mutation until that analytic reruns clean, despite existing plan authorization.

assertions.name: no-partial-baseline
assertions.check: The crash is retained as N/A and the complete baseline is not claimed from three successful analytics.

assertions.name: authorization-does-not-replace-evidence
assertions.check: No APPLY mutation occurs until the failed local analytic reruns clean.

evals.name: approved-single-spoke-refile
evals.prompt: The ranked plan explicitly approves moving spoke S from hub A to hub B, and the existing user instruction authorizes applying that exact item. Describe the ordered, reversible toolchain; do not run it. S is HOT and has local edits. The tree MCP is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Snapshot family/out-of-family files, reconcile HOT edits, complete crossroute cleanup and referent repair, defer the remote tree link honestly, then verify gates; no repeated routine approval.

assertions.name: preserves-hot-spoke-work
assertions.check: The plan does not raw-rm a HOT spoke or overwrite its divergent edits; it uses the documented tiering/reconciliation rail.

assertions.name: completes-both-ownership-sides
assertions.check: The old manifest row, old routing row and old reference are removed/superseded after the new copy is verified, followed by referent repair.

assertions.name: records-unavailable-tree-link
assertions.check: The remote tree link is deferred explicitly; it does not invent success or block local APPLY solely on the optional remote signal.

assertions.name: recognizes-existing-authorization
assertions.check: The existing approval of this concrete plan is honored without another routine confirmation.

evals.name: healthy-tree-and-hard-description-cap
evals.prompt: The complete tree baseline is valid. One standalone description has 1100 characters but no other actionable finding exists; a second run has no actionable finding at all. Classify the first issue and state the healthy-run exit.
evals.expected_output: The 1100-character description is High under the current /sko 1000 cap and handed to skill-optimizer; the healthy run reports baseline/no action and skips APPLY/VERIFY.

assertions.name: uses-current-cap-severity
assertions.check: The 1100-character description is High, never Medium or below the hard cap.

assertions.name: healthy-run-stops-without-mutation
assertions.check: With no actionable plan item the run reports no action required and does not invent APPLY or probe evidence.
